budget_scope: New Australian source data, segmentation, vectors, indexes, caches, outputs and peak temporary files. Preserved international holdings are outside this envelope and methods-reference only.
execution_authorisation: Research/planning only; no corpus download, collection, model, data rewrite, runtime quota or migration is released by this calculator.

scenario_assumptions.model_selection_note: 384/1024 dimensions compare capacity only. Neither model nor float16 precision is adopted without task validation; current helper stores float32.
